title: Demote Shiba companion to mascot-only on / and /me, remove global PresenceConnector, slim Battle lobby

spec.problem: CompanionBot runs useCompanionEngine timers and /api/companion/hint chat on every route, PresenceConnector opens a global /ws/presence socket and PvP popups on every page, /battle exposes 9 arcade modes, global chat, and a false reconnect box when human presence is empty, and Profile/Search contain dead PvP/battle CTAs.

acceptance.text: LearnerAppFrame renders CompanionBot only when pathname is /{locale} or /{locale}/me, and omits it on /levels, /quiz, /flashcards, /search, /news, /pricing, /scenarios, and /battle.

CompanionBot runs in mascot-only mode without mounting useCompanionEngine, idle intervals, CompanionChatPanel, CompanionOnboarding, or /api/companion/hint fetches; tapping Shiba cycles a localized short speech bubble via CompanionSpeechBubble that auto-hides after 4s.

AuthShell removes the global PresenceConnector mount while keeping hooks/use-presence.ts on disk; BattleLobbyClient removes the false presence.length===0 lobbyConnectionOffline box, hides human presence, unmounts BattleConfigsPanel and global lobby chat, and BattleRuntimeProvider skips /api/battle/chat/recent while preserving 1v1 bot drills and Leaderboard.
ProfileActions hides the dead PvP challenge button while retaining the friends badge; SearchDetailPanel removes the Đấu bot (/battle) CTA while retaining /quiz and /flashcards CTAs.

Updated and new unit tests cover all WEB-443 contracts with §5 justification for companion-bot.test.tsx; Strategy (a) files, companionRive assets, theme-contrast.regression.test.ts, and frontend-debt floors stay green untouched.

spec.expected_behavior: CompanionBot mounts only on /{locale} and /{locale}/me in mascot-only mode without useCompanionEngine, idle loops, chat/onboarding panels, or /api/companion/hint calls, responding to taps with a cycling localized speech bubble that auto-hides after 4s; AuthShell unmounts PresenceConnector while keeping hooks/use-presence.ts on disk; BattleLobbyClient shows a clean 1v1 bot drill selector (J1-J4) + Start + Leaderboard with no BattleConfigsPanel, no global chat, no human presence roster, and no fake lobbyConnectionOffline box, and BattleRuntimeProvider skips /api/battle/chat/recent; ProfileActions hides the PvP challenge button; SearchDetailPanel removes the Đấu bot CTA.
spec.observed_behavior: LearnerAppFrame mounts CompanionBot on all routes with useCompanionEngine, chat panel, onboarding modal, and /api/companion/hint calls; AuthShell mounts PresenceConnector globally; BattleLobbyClient renders BattleConfigsPanel, global chat, human presence, and a fake lobbyConnectionOffline box when presence.length===0 while BattleRuntimeProvider fetches /api/battle/chat/recent; ProfileActions renders a PvP challenge button; SearchDetailPanel renders a Đấu bot CTA.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert LearnerAppFrame, CompanionBot, CompanionSpeechBubble, AuthShell, BattleLobbyClient, BattleRuntimeProvider, ProfileActions, and SearchDetailPanel edits; all Strategy (a) companion, presence, and battle component files remain untouched on disk.

classification.rationale: Web-only Strategy (a) focus slice: scopes CompanionBot to /{locale} and /{locale}/me in mascot-only tap-bubble mode, unmounts global PresenceConnector from AuthShell, slims BattleLobbyClient and skips /api/battle/chat/recent, hides dead PvP/battle CTAs in ProfileActions and SearchDetailPanel, and updates companion-bot.test.tsx per ENGINEERING_POLICY.md §5 while preserving all underlying files and assets on disk.
